sfxPolicy: Voice-first. No whooshes/risers/impacts on cuts or pull-backs. SFX only on text events: typing rattle (first typed subtitle), tick (1 f before the cut into the turn word), pop + ding on the turn word glyphs. Optional click when the arch lands.

typingRattleHF.desc: train of tiny transients above 11 kHz, one every 22-46 ms (~22 Hz), 480 ms long, +40 dB over the HF band median

tickHF.desc: 6.64 kHz tonal tick + broadband >11 kHz burst, ~50 ms
tickHF.recipeNote: audio.py recipe (engine v2). Fitted on ref3_third 8.58-8.68 s: per-21 ms-frame peak of the 6.4-6.9 kHz band and of the >11 kHz band sit within 1 dB of each other (the built-in tickHF put the burst 6 dB under the tone); slower 26 dB decay = the reference's ~50 ms tail

popHF.desc: short pop with spectral peak ~10-10.7 kHz, ~90 ms
popHF.recipeNote: audio.py recipe (engine v2). The reference pop (8.68-8.85 s) spreads 8-13 kHz and holds ~50 ms; a slower decay and a wider noise layer give it the reference's energy at a lower peak (spec sounds are normalised to -3 dBFS peak)

ding4k.desc: 4.19 kHz fundamental + 8.38 kHz partial (partial 2.6 dB louder), decays ~25 dB by 220 ms, ~300 ms ring

sfx.note: only the first typed subtitle of the reel gets typing audio (3.61-4.09 s); engine v2 honours onlyFirstInReel
sfx.levelNote: engine path: the built-in typingRattleHF train is normalised to -3 dBFS peak and has a ~27 dB crest factor, so at -1 dB (peak -4 dBFS) its >11 kHz energy is still ~4-5 dB under the reference (ref per-frame HF max -10.4 dB at 3.6-4.1 s). For the reference level bake it into the bed (demo/make_bed.py --sfx typing@T, soft-limited, crest ~18 dB) and set "sfx": false on that cue, as the doctor demo does
with the soundSpecs recipe: 6.4-6.9 kHz per-frame peak -12.7 dB, >11 kHz -13.7 dB vs reference -12.8 / -14.0 dB (native demo, same plate audio level)
sfx.note: one frame before the cut into the pop shot (8.62-8.66 s)

sfx.levelNote: spec peak -1.5 dBFS (the ceiling before the -1 dBFS master limiter): 9.5-11.5 kHz per-frame peak -3.8 dB, >11 kHz -11.2 dB vs reference -1.6 / -9.3 dB (the reference pop is mastered into clipping)
sfx.note: at peak growth of the first glyph (8.71-8.80 s)

sfx.levelNote: built-in ding4k at spec peak -1.5 dBFS: 4.19 / 8.38 kHz band peaks -6.0 / -3.4 dB vs reference -3.4 / -2.7 dB

wideFace.rule: head top 34-35% H, face ~35-40% H: no opaque element

msPanels.note: sub 'مايختار المدرس بس من سمعته' measured x39-450 / y830-869 @720 at f340: centred under the hero (centre 244.5 vs 247.5), min side margin 39 px @720 = 5.4% W

layerOrder.contents: wall / backdrop (real red set or bg-replace gradient; void in the reveal)
neon line and ghost echo words (wall depth)
kashida word / display word behind the head (needs roto)
ghost word inside the arch (under the glass)
glass: arch, pills, corner panels (old words frosted under them)
crisp white type and the red UI on top of the glass

director.note: srt2scene's punch logic is disabled: this style never pushes in. Add the 4 pull-backs by hand (hook x2, breather, brand). Drafted starred captions become the validation-beat grammar (fade-rise hero at 68.8% + typed Light line at 75.6%); autoSfx gives the typing rattle to the first typewriter-sub only (onlyFirstInReel). fade-rise-word starts later words at 45% opacity: the engine (v2 unit gating) keeps each word hidden until its own stagger start. End every karaoke-sweep cue ~100 ms before the cut so the band has left the line.

componentHints.note: not read by srt2scene.py; defaults proven by demo/scene_doctor.json (foreign plate) and demo/scene_native.json (reference plate), see STYLE.md 'Engine implementation'

talent.filterNote: per-plate exposure trim after grade.css: tune until skin peaks land at Y 165-175 and plate p99.5 <= 170 (doctor plate: 1.25 gave p99 165 vs reference tight shot 178); contrast(1.05) crushes the lifted blacks (Y p5 7-9 -> ~4)
talent.edgeNote: the matte's opaque rim can still carry the original wall (teal light wrap on ears / neck): crimson-talent decontaminates every non-interior pixel to the nearby interior colour, erodes ~1 px, then darkens and pulls the edge toward the red wrap

foreignSet.persistent: keep style persistent (sunburst-halo + plate-vignette) and size them per scene with scene.persistentProps: {"sunburst-halo": {"restScale": <wide rest scale>}, "plate-vignette": {"overStudio": {"wide": 0.25, "mcu": 0.25}}}. restScale gives the halo the reference wide's SCREEN size (inner 159 / outer 515 px) at that camera scale, so it does not balloon with a big head; the halo is occluded by the presenter's matte. The vignette runs at 25% over crimson-studio (the fitted gradients already carry the falloff; 40% made the MCU wall R 56-78 vs 77-89)

referenceSet.note: reference plates already carry the grade, vignette and practical sunburst

framing.wide: camera scale that puts the head top at 34-35% H with the head ~2x smaller than in the tight shot (x1.9-2.6 flip). An MCU-only 1080x1920 source (the doctor plate: no full-body take) rests its wides at ~0.53 (head ~250 px; 0.62 gave a x1.6 flip and a 300 px head); x offset to centre the face; crimson-talent feathers the plate edges; hide the plate's lower edge under the arch in the hook. The lower third stays dark wall/floor: never fill it with rays or type
framing.mcuOnlySource: renders/plates/doctor is an MCU-only source: no seated full-body wide exists, so the reference's small figure in a big room cannot be rebuilt; the 0.53 'wide' is a feathered bust
framing.pullbacks: multiply the preset scaleFrom/scaleTo by the shot's rest scale (e.g. pullback-expo-open 1.69x0.62 -> 0.62) and set "worldRest": "final" on that camera cue ("start" on a settle-float continuing from it) so world-locked type lands on its slot

componentHints.cuts: a hard cut is a camera cue {"move": "static", "scaleTo": <shot scale>, "x", "y", "focus": "centre"} plus the next shot's crimson-studio variant, timed in a speech pause; engine v2 camera cues are cuts (a later cue replaces a still-running move, no motion blur across the cut), so any time works
componentHints.difference: place the Difference question / slam just below the chin so the stroke tops cross the neck / V-neck skin (white -> teal over skin, red -> green) and the rest crosses the wall (cyan #ACFAF6 needs a wall of R ~80 under it); never on the beard or face. Rise on the cut frame, swap-out with one empty frame, slam on its spoken onset

music.gainDb: set so the band below 70 Hz sits ~3 dB under the 100 Hz-4 kHz voice band

bed.sfx: engine v2 plays the soundSpecs (tickHF / popHF recipes, built-in ding4k / clickHF / typingRattleHF) at the calibrated rule gains. Only the typing rattle cannot reach the reference level through the peak-normalised spec: bake it into the bed (make_bed.py --sfx typing@T) and set "sfx": false on that typewriter-sub

componentHints.mux: render.mjs --out (engine v2) pads the mix and cuts it to exactly frames / fps, so every frame is kept: no manual mux

do: One family: Almarai 800 for anything that must punch (Arabic and Latin wordmark), Almarai 300 for every supporting line
Flat warm white #FDFBF9 type with no stroke, glow or shadow; the dark red set and vignette carry legibility
Monochrome red world: wall #4E0005, rays #6B0505, shadows #1C0000; accents stay red/pink (#F03039 sweep, #CF0108 neon, #EC0206 script, #FE030A UI)
One beat at a time: 1 hero (141 px) + 1 Light subtitle (52 px), 3-7 words, hero:sub ~2.7:1, never wrap
Wide shots: type in the top band (8-27% H) or a display word that interacts with the body; MCU: chest band 50-82% H
Glass is the house material: backdrop blur 5-10 px, darken 10-14%, 2-3 px white hairline at 14-37%, capsules r=h/2, arches/corners r 375-425 px
Stage depth with type: new word crisp in front, previous word frosted behind glass, red ghost echo behind the hero, thin kashida word behind the head
Kashida only on Light or outline words (8 / 3 / 3 tatweels measured); bold heroes unstretched except the one turn word (2)
Emphasise with light: a ~92 px pink-red band sweeps right->left over the white hero and leaves it white
Fade long lines out at one horizontal end (alpha ramp over the outer 26-27% of the line)
Sunburst halo just above the head, behind the talent, only +30-35 R over the wall
Every camera move is a centred digital pull-back; captions in hook/brand shots are cameraLocked so the camera delivers them
Hard cuts in speech pauses, flipping tight <-> wide; ASL ~2.7 s, 1.4-1.7 s in the agitation beat, 3-3.5 s for moving shots
Two text-free breathers of ~3.3-3.7 s, one filled with a slow pull-back + foreground parallax roses
SFX only on 3-4 text events (typing rattle, tick/pop/ding on the turn word); loud 41 Hz sub bed ~3 dB under the voice
Difference blend for question words across the torso (white -> cyan over red; red -> green over beige), max 2 words, same shot
End on the headline cascade + outline pill + typed label, then hold 1.3 s with no outro
dont: No second Arabic family, no Arabic 400-700 weights, no tracking on Arabic
No strokes, drop shadows or glows on white type; no boxes or solid plates behind text
No cool colours except what difference blend produces; no cyan/green fills
No push-ins, whip pans, dissolves, flashes, speed ramps, whooshes, risers or impacts on cuts or zooms
No opaque element over the face; glass may cover body and old words, never the face
No text below 86.6% H or above 8.3% H
No self-animated exits longer than 2-3 frames; everything else leaves on the cut
No beat-sync; cuts and type follow speech syllables
No foreground 3D props in shots that carry text
Never vignette or grade the graphics; never put the vignette in the fx layer above captions
No grain, no bloom on the plate (glow only on neon, ghost words and roses)

residualUncertainty: Script accent family (Pinyon Script vs Great Vibes / Italianno) and its size (~172 px @1080) are low confidence; CDN was blocked for the look analyst
'your content' face: Inter 500 vs Helvetica Neue / SF Pro Medium cannot be separated at 32 px ink
Neon headline size 134 px @1080 is fitted to a full ink width that is partly masked (+-5%); tatweel count 3 is read from the frame
Sunburst: practical projection/print vs 2D layer tracked behind a roto'd talent; it behaves as plate-locked either way
Extreme-wide void: AI outpaint vs CG/stock; presenter scale x0.27 full-frame (verifier) vs x0.32-0.36 on the presenter (motion)
Hidden jump cut at f39 under the split exit is plausible, not provable
Tight shots: second camera vs 4K punch-in (detail suggests a high-res source)
Glass-panel travel vectors combine the motion report (TL bottom edge 92->649) and the verifier (BR top at x700 1185->559, TL right edge 109->280); exact start offsets +-10%
Bell base tilt (-25 deg) and arc count from a 48x42 px object
Music tempo unresolved (86 vs 115 BPM); bed has no drums
Grade CSS values are a starting point tuned for a normally exposed source; verify against grade.targets
